why: Both analyses land on low-cost steel, profit per ton, the three key stop-doing items and the key brutal facts, but Analysis 1 explicitly names the culture as the engine and the purchasable technology as the accelerator, and takes a firmer line against import protection. Analysis 2 has the tighter, more actionable one-screen verdict with a stated confidence level, but its hedgehog centres slightly more on scrap conversion than on culture.
